title: Kestrel Vehicle Return Standard and Wear Charge Schedule for Closed-End Consumer Leases
content:
**The Kestrel wear standard — Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease (identical in all six tiers)**

A wear item found at inspection is either within the Kestrel wear standard or excess. The measurable limits of the standard are:

| Measure | Within the standard | Excess |
|---|---|---|
| Dent or scratch | shorter than 2 inches | 2 inches or longer |
| Windshield chip | smaller than 1 inch and outside the driver's view | 1 inch or larger, or any chip in the driver's view |
| Tire tread | 4/32 of an inch or deeper, tires matched | below 4/32 of an inch, or mismatched |

**Charge per excess item, by category**

| Wear item category | Charge per item |
|---|---|
| Body dent | $175 |
| Body scratch | $145 |
| Windshield or glass | $450 |
| Tire | $225 |
| Wheel | $250 |
| Interior upholstery | $300 |
| Missing key | $375 |
| Missing equipment | $150 |
| Mechanical or light | $120 |

Items within the standard carry a charge of $0.00.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical items)**

- A scratch of 1.9 inches is within the standard; a scratch of exactly 2 inches is excess and is charged $145.
- A windshield chip of 0.5 inch outside the driver's view is within the standard; the same chip in the driver's view is excess and is charged $450.
- A tire with 4/32 of an inch of tread is within the standard; one with 3/32 is excess and is charged $225.
